name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server for searching the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace + Degen Arena + portfolio risk scoring + cross-portfolio composition. Exposes 39 tools — including v0.12.0 surfacing of Metabot v1.10 Phase 3 paid offerings (acp_search_narrative, acp_agent_risk_check) plus 9 new optional v1.10 fields on acp_find (Phase 1+2 negative filters + sub-offering filters), v0.10.0 composites (acp_hire_decision, acp_safe_quote, acp_portfolio_status), OracleBot Resource wrappers (acp_oracle_sources, acp_oracle_drift, acp_oracle_capabilities), v0.9.1 risk bundle (acp_agent_verify and friends), Degen Arena tools, and the v0.7+ Resources / cost / feed-address suite — backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
